text:
sam: heads up  we discovered a couple of debug traces with full request_body for the embeddings route from last night. looks like a config mismatch during a deploy.
elena: can you paste an anonymized snippet? curious what field name leaked.
sam: sure (redacted):
```
{ "route": "/v1/embeddings", "request_body": "<REDACTED>", "tenant": "tenant-a", "req_id": "r-123" }
```
ty: thanks. quick note: our current sampler + scrub order is proxy -> sampler -> scrub, which means sampled copies can escape before scrub. we should move scrub earlier or ensure sampler works on scrubbed envelope.
carter: prefer moving scrub to ingress so no downstream system ever sees plaintext. downside: harder to debug for support.
elena: ops proposal: default = fingerprint-only ingest (fp:v1:<hex>), optional encrypted capture to audit-vault when a multi-approver console flow approves. also add per-tenant sampling caps to limit storage.
ty: sampling idea: tiered base rates (free=0.001, paid=0.01, enterprise=0.05) + burst bucket (tokens/day). when burst exhausted, fallback to fingerprint-only.
carter: UX asks: console should show "Raw capture allowed" badge (red/green) and an audit card with last_approved_by and justification. toggling on must open modal listing required approvers and create a signed approval record.
sam: security: any encrypted capture must be KMS-wrapped and accessible only via a restricted worker with IP/RBAC guardrails. and every decrypt should emit an immutable audit-entry.
elena: retention defaults: hosted 30d (fingerprint) + encrypted captures 30d; enterprise can request 90/365 via contract.
ty: incremental rollout: 1) change pre-ingest hook to scrub before sampler (feature-flagged), 2) implement fp:v1 schema + HMAC per-tenant salt, 3) add console approval flow + badge behind FF, 4) sample caps + burst enforcement.
carter: owners: ty(hook + sampler) 3d, elena(approval UX) 1w, sam(audit + KMS policy) security signoff 3d.
audit-bot: nightly-scan: 2 hits detected last 24h; flagged and ticketed LOG-PII-6123.
sam: ok we should pause any manual unmasking until console flow exists. also add a detector metric that fires if request_body length > 100 and route == "/v1/embeddings".
elena: will mock badge and modal tonight; will include copy for required approver roles.
ty: implementing hook first in staging, will run a canary for low-volume tenants.
carter: adding runbook steps: detect -> flip feature flag -> rotate ephemeral support tokens -> notify security + tenant -> copy any raw artifacts to audit-vault + mark for purge.
sam: thanks team. reopening if we see new hits after the canary.
